title: Add structured logging with levels to puppeteer Python code
description:
The puppeteer Python code uses bare print() statements throughout for all output — debug info, status updates, warnings, and errors all go to the same stream with no way to filter by severity. We should switch to Python's logging module with proper levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR) so that:

- Normal runs show INFO+ by default (game lifecycle, results)
- DEBUG is available via a flag for troubleshooting (MCP message details, process management)
- Warnings and errors are visually distinct and easy to grep for
- Log output can be directed to files vs console independently

This would make post-mortem analysis of failed games much easier — right now you have to read through all output to find the relevant error.
